verdict.rationale: ByteAsk has no native always-on, scheduled, or trigger-based agents. It does document a headless `byteask exec` mode for scripting and CI pipelines. That mode runs one task to completion and exits, emits JSON Lines and schema-conforming output, and accepts `--sandbox workspace-write` so it can build, test, and edit files. Autonomous maintenance is therefore only achievable by wiring exec into external CI or cron schedulers. Missing for 10: built-in scheduling or event triggers, persistent always-on agent runtime, documented unattended auto-fix workflows (e.g. auto-PRs), independent or hands-on corroboration.
